digest.component_or_area: capability registry and optional dependency enforcement
propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that each of 14 immutable capability records maps a semantic key to exactly one declared packaging extra and exactly one typed missing posture (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without importing probe packages.

Stable CLI commands and top-level help must remain present in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection emit OptionalDependencyError for error-posture capabilities.
Lean diagnostic, read, and dry-run modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities (e.g., audit show without audit_ui; review/workflow diagnostics without agent_runtime).
Domain components retain control of result payloads, exceptions, and logging for unavailable/abstain/fallback postures; the registry provides metadata only, never manufactures domain results.
Separate entry points mcp_server and review_bot must be registry capabilities but not appear in the top-level CLI route registry.
